title: Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer & Draftsman
application_fee: Rs. 750 for General/OBC, Rs. 500 for SC/ST/Cat-1/Ex-Servicemen, Rs. 250 for PwBD
age_limit: 18 to 40 years (with category-wise age relaxations up to 45 years)
summary: Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) has invited online applications for the recruitment of 187 Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer (Civil), and Draftsman posts across various departments in Karnataka. Eligible candidates holding a Diploma can apply through the official KEA website before the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Must hold a Diploma in Civil Engineering, Landscape Architecture, Transportation Planning, or equivalent from a recognized institute.
Minimum age is 18 years; maximum age varies up to 45 years depending on the category.
Candidates must pass the compulsory Kannada language examination where applicable.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Assistant Town Planner (Urban Development Authority & Town and Country Planning Directorate)
Junior Engineer (Civil) - Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP)
Junior Engineer (Civil) - Karnataka Rural Infrastructure Development Limited

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official KEA website at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/
Read the detailed notification carefully and click on the online application link for the respective posts.
Fill in all required personal and educational details accurately.
Upload scanned copies of recent passport size photograph with white background and signature in JPEG format.
Pay the prescribed application fee through online mode and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee challan.
